title: zero-gravity workspace
summary: an adaptable reclined workstation specification; the bali product list is awaiting an original build contribution.

components.name: reclining chair with leg and head support
requirements: record reclined footprint in cm and manufacturer load limit in kg
verify stability through the full intended range
check access, exit space, and head support for the user

components.name: height-adjustable desk or suitable support structure
requirements: record minimum and maximum height in cm
verify the mounting surface and rated load for the proposed arms
check that the frame does not collide with the recliner

components.name: adjustable arm and retained laptop tray
requirements: record laptop plus tray mass in kg and compatible load range
verify the lowest usable tray position, reach, and tilt
confirm the laptop is mechanically retained in the intended orientation

components.name: adjustable monitor arm
requirements: record monitor plus adapters mass in kg and mount pattern in mm
verify reach and tilt against the actual reclined eye position
confirm manufacturer permits the intended orientation

components.name: armrest pads or other suitable forearm support
requirements: check dimensions and interference during entry and exit
identify a removable material suitable for the local climate
